title: Normalization of the transported scalar unit on finite coefficients
statement: For finite commutative rings A,B, a ring homomorphism φ:A→B and any scheme S, VectorTraceScalar.unit φ S [def-pur-vector-trace-scalar-coefficient-data] equals ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ S.hom [lem-pur-exceptional-coefficient-comparison]. Thus transporting the multiplication-normalized derived scalar unit through the published single/unit identifications changes no arrow.

source.place: Paragraph 2, coefficient compatibility of vector integration; reduction compatibilities (3), Orientation.

proof.text: For arbitrary coefficient categories, the published singleFunctorObjUnitIso_inv in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.ProjectionFormula.Unit says the canonical single/unit isomorphism has identity inverse. Its hom is identity by hom_inv_id. Unfold purityTransportUnitMap, apply preservation of identity and the category identity laws, and specialize to ModuleCat A and ModuleCat B. The statement includes empty schemes and zero rings.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph 2, coefficient compatibility of vector integration; reduction compatibilities (3), Orientation.
proof_origin.note: A generic category identity specializes to the canonical single/unit isomorphisms, whose inverse is proved to be identity in the adopted source.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarUnit_normalization
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    VectorTraceScalar.unit φ S = (ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ S).hom
